title: ruta graveolens var. crithmifolia
intro: Ruta graveolens var. crithmifolia, commonly known as Sea Rue, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to improved cardiovascular health and reduced oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Sea Rue are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce spasms, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential remedy for various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Sea Rue include flavonoids, alkaloids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
